latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the DG-LAB Coyote 3.0 local control skill.

- Enables control of pulse device via WebSocket and HTTP API on localhost.
- Guides users through environment checks, component installation, server startup, pairing, and all safety precautions.
- Supports device pairing with QR code, channel selection (A/B), strength and waveform management, and emergency stop.
- Enforces strict safety and privacy measures: local-only communication, explicit user safety confirmation, and no data collection or upload.
- Provides preset and custom waveform support, plus extensive references and user instructions.
